description: Recipe taxonomy for FilmDeck scenes with evidence from the two reference decks. 8 recipes are parameterised (generator-ready); the others are reference-code-only.

statusVocabulary.demonstrated: a complete working scene exists in a reference deck, with deck-specific content hardcoded
statusVocabulary.partial: only part of the described recipe exists in the references

implementationStatus.reference-code-only: the code to adapt is the reference scene itself; no template, no input schema
implementationStatus.parameterised: a renderer exists in engine/recipes: inputs schema + scene/CSS templates; used by tools/generate-deck.mjs

reuseReadinessVocabulary.high: data-driven or simple DOM; adapting means replacing constants
reuseReadinessVocabulary.medium: needs layout adjustment and some bespoke art
reuseReadinessVocabulary.low: bespoke simulation; adapt by copying and editing, do not parameterise

recipes.name: Cold open: particles form a word, word cycles, reveal
recipes.visualPurpose: Opening that poses the central question and resolves it into one claim
recipes.whenToUse: Scene 1 of a talk with a single provocative question
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.deterministic: structure only (scramble letters and particles are random)
recipes.audioNotes: boom x3, whoosh, tick+hit per cycled word, riser
recipes.notes: Uses letterbox and a minimal pad mood; contains a 'not equal' SVG that is specific to the MBA message

recipes.name: People grid: figures turn red and leave, counter ticks
recipes.visualPurpose: Show attrition or loss as people departing from a workforce
recipes.whenToUse: A count of people lost out of a population (opening or problem scene)
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.deterministic: no: which figures leave is random each build
recipes.audioNotes: riser, boom, whoosh+tick per exit
recipes.notes: Canvas scene; the exit count must be supplied (hardcoded 12 today)

recipes.name: Ecosystem: centre node, rings pull out, links, moving packets
recipes.visualPurpose: Show how parts of a system connect
recipes.whenToUse: A business/system described by one core and satellite parts
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.audioNotes: boom, blip rising per node, riser, chime
recipes.notes: Only scene with exitFx; geometry is polar from radii 200/345/445

recipes.name: Branching decision tree grows, freezes, one path lit, DECIDE / ACT
recipes.visualPurpose: Show a widening decision space ending in a chosen path
recipes.whenToUse: Decision making, option analysis
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.deterministic: no: growth is random and time-dependent (NOW, INSTANT pre-roll)
recipes.audioNotes: tick, riser, glitch, chime, boom
recipes.notes: Bespoke canvas simulation; replay approximates rather than reproduces

recipes.name: 3D puzzle pieces scatter then lock; beam runs PROBLEM to ACTION
recipes.visualPurpose: Show parts assembling into a process
recipes.whenToUse: A multi-part framework that becomes a sequence
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.audioNotes: whoosh per piece, snap on lock, boom, hit+tick per stage
recipes.notes: metric strings in the reference are invented placeholders; make them optional

recipes.name: Orbit of people with speech bubbles, conflict then collaboration
recipes.visualPurpose: Show differing perspectives around a decision-maker
recipes.whenToUse: Stakeholders, roles, team dynamics
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.deterministic: structure only (conflict zigzag and sparks random)
recipes.audioNotes: chime, blip rising, glitch, hit
recipes.notes: 6 actors hand-positioned

recipes.name: Word cracks into 3D shards, becomes a new word, camera dolly to the leader
recipes.visualPurpose: Contrast two ideas (manage vs lead) and show a team following
recipes.whenToUse: A before/after word pair plus a 4-label strip
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.audioNotes: crack, boom, whoosh, riser, chime x4
recipes.notes: Uses this-binding; canvas pseudo-3D; slot morph; bespoke

recipes.name: Chaos (glitch, flying words, tickers, dot globe) snapped into an ordered grid
recipes.visualPurpose: Show noise becoming a structured framework
recipes.whenToUse: Environment/forces mapped to lenses
inputs: tickerStrings[] (optional, must be non-numeric unless sourced)
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.audioNotes: riser, glitch interval, boom, snap per row
recipes.notes: Heaviest scene (27 random calls, canvas glitch); tickers in the reference are invented numbers

recipes.name: Light-seam wipe from one world (chalkboard) into another (live dashboards)
recipes.visualPurpose: Contrast theory with reality
recipes.whenToUse: Two contexts side by side in time
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.audioNotes: chalk, whoosh, riser, tick per card, boom, chime
recipes.notes: Card figures are invented placeholders; mini visuals are bespoke

recipes.name: Orbs appear and network, vortex pulls them into one word, which explodes into the final word
recipes.visualPurpose: Many strengths converge into one outcome
recipes.whenToUse: A list of 6 benefits merging into a result
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.audioNotes: chime per note, blip, riser, boom, crack
recipes.notes: Best-structured MBA scene: data-driven loop over orbs; 9 beats is the longest scene

recipes.name: Gauge needle sweeps from before to after
recipes.visualPurpose: Show a rate changing
recipes.whenToUse: One metric with a before and after value
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.audioNotes: riser, hit, blip, boom, glitch
recipes.notes: Shares scene s2 with recipe 12: scene boundary of the recipe is a beat range, not a whole scene (UNRESOLVED how to split)

inputContract.facts: before and after: number or range fact; both must lie inside the scale

capabilities.name: Gauge needle, before to after
capabilities.sourceReferences: every fact used needs sourceRef and an exact evidence quote
capabilities.purpose: Show one rate moving from a before value to an after value on a dial.
knownLimitations: one metric per scene
fixed 3 beats
scale limited to 60 minor and 10 major ticks
both values must lie inside the scale

recipes.name: Icon rows (before and now) then ranked bars
recipes.visualPurpose: Show a count doubling and rank categories
recipes.whenToUse: Two compared counts plus a ranking
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.audioNotes: tick per icon, boom, whoosh, hit
recipes.notes: Second half of Velcure s2; bar lengths are decorative, rank is the data

inputContract.facts: row counts: whole-number facts 1 to 20 (a range shows uncertain icons hollow); bar values: number or range facts listed in descending order, display up to 8 characters

capabilities.name: Icon rows (before and now) then ranked bars
inputTypes: fact-ref (whole-number counts 1 to 20 for icon rows)
capabilities.sourceReferences: every fact used needs sourceRef and an exact evidence quote
capabilities.purpose: Show a change in a count with rows of unit icons (people or neutral blocks), then rank categories by size.
knownLimitations: icon "person" draws people (use it only when the counts ARE people, as in the Velcure reference); the default icon "block" is a neutral unit mark for anything else (centres, stores, tickets)
exactly two icon rows
icon counts must be whole numbers 1 to 20 (a range shows the uncertain icons hollow)
ranked items must be given in descending order
bar length is proportional to the fact value; rank numbers are not drawn (they would be unsourced digits)

recipes.name: Range bar chart to scale, gap bracket, verdict word
recipes.visualPurpose: Compare ranges on one scale and name the primary cause
recipes.whenToUse: Salary/price/percentage ranges and a conclusion
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.audioNotes: riser, boom, hit, glitch, blip
recipes.notes: The reference for charts drawn to scale; uses one linear X scale; beat 3 switches particles to flow mode

inputContract.beats: 2 + (1 if more than one row or a gap) + (1 if cards) + 1 = 3 to 5
inputContract.facts: row values: number or range facts inside the scale; gap value: a number fact that must equal the drawn distance between the two edges (use a derived fact)

capabilities.name: Range bar chart on one scale, gap bracket, verdict
capabilities.beats: 2 + (1 if more than one row or a gap) + (1 if cards) + 1 = 3 to 5
capabilities.sourceReferences: every fact used needs sourceRef and an exact evidence quote
capabilities.purpose: Compare 1 to 4 values or ranges on one shared scale, optionally with a gap bracket and cards, ending on a verdict word.
knownLimitations: one shared scale for all rows
gap bracket only between adjacent rows and must equal the drawn distance
at most 12 grid steps
value labels must fit left of x=1810 (raise scale.max)

recipes.name: Blanket vs targeted: people grid plus cost meter against a budget line; scanner picks targets
recipes.visualPurpose: Argue for selective action over across-the-board action
recipes.whenToUse: A cost/benefit contrast with a targeted alternative
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.audioNotes: riser, boom, crack, whoosh, blip per target, chime, hit
recipes.notes: Meter heights are pixel metaphors; do not label with numbers unless sourced

recipes.name: Animated emblem trio: boomerang loop, dot climbing stairs, pulsing star
recipes.visualPurpose: Three qualities each with a symbol
recipes.whenToUse: Three parallel ideas
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.audioNotes: chime per column (C4, E4, G4), boom, hit
recipes.notes: Three bespoke emblems; a new third emblem needs new SVG

recipes.name: Leaking tank: exits are leaks, plugs are retention, tap is recruitment
recipes.visualPurpose: Explain balancing loss and inflow
recipes.whenToUse: Retention vs recruitment, churn vs acquisition
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.audioNotes: riser, hit, snap per plug, whoosh, blip, boom
recipes.notes: Canvas fluid simulation; bespoke

recipes.name: Pillars rise one by one and a roof drops on top
recipes.visualPurpose: Show a strategy supported by parts
recipes.whenToUse: A 3-part strategy with sub-points
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.audioNotes: riser, boom + shake per pillar, crack + flash on roof
recipes.notes: Simplest recipe (about 2 KB)

inputContract.facts: none; text only (numbers in text must still come from facts)

capabilities.name: Three pillars rise, roof drops on top
capabilities.sourceReferences: none required (text only; digits in text are rejected unless they are fact displays)
capabilities.purpose: Three supports under one overarching idea (a framework, a strategy, three reasons).
knownLimitations: exactly three pillars
text only: digits are rejected unless they are fact displays, so use another recipe for numbers
fixed 5 beats

recipes.name: Headline with strike-through, three moves, then a checklist that ticks off
recipes.visualPurpose: Reject one approach and give the recommendation
recipes.whenToUse: A recommendation scene
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.audioNotes: hit, boom, crack, chime, whoosh, snap per item
recipes.notes: Pure DOM; contains a list item with a source range

capabilities.name: Headline with strike-through, three moves, checklist
capabilities.sourceReferences: none required (text only; digits in text are rejected unless they are fact displays)
capabilities.purpose: Reject a bad approach (struck-through headline), propose three moves and tick off a checklist.
knownLimitations: exactly three moves
text only
fixed 4 beats

recipes.name: Minimal close: serif quote lines, giant final word with sheen, held
recipes.visualPurpose: End the talk
recipes.whenToUse: Last scene
recipes.output: one scene module: def({...}) + scene CSS (prefix per scene)
recipes.deterministic: yes (no randomness except FX which fades out)
recipes.audioNotes: chime x3, boom
recipes.notes: Identical structure in both decks (4 beats in MBA, 3 in Velcure; MBA adds a 3-word build before the final word)

capabilities.name: Minimal close or open: serif lines, giant word with sheen
capabilities.sourceReferences: none required (text only; digits in text are rejected unless they are fact displays)
capabilities.purpose: Open or close the deck with two serif lines and one giant word.
knownLimitations: text only
fixed 3 beats
the giant word must be 16 characters or fewer

recipes.name: Big number (KPI): one hero figure counts up, with context and an optional comparison
recipes.visualPurpose: Make one figure the whole point of the scene
recipes.whenToUse: A single headline KPI, optionally against a previous value
recipes.audioNotes: riser, boom, chime
recipes.notes: Composite of Velcure counter/readout timing; no single reference scene.

inputContract.facts: value and compare.value: number or range facts; display up to 12 characters

capabilities.name: Big number (KPI): one hero figure counts up, with context and an optional comparison
capabilities.sourceReferences: every fact used needs sourceRef and an exact evidence quote
capabilities.purpose: Make one figure the whole point of the scene (a headline KPI), optionally against a previous value.
knownLimitations: one figure per scene
the count-up animates the first number of the display; ranges are revealed without counting
display text longer than 12 characters is rejected

recipes.name: Comparison: two options side by side, matching metrics, then a verdict line
recipes.visualPurpose: Put two options side by side on matching metrics
recipes.whenToUse: Two groups, periods or options compared on 1 to 3 measures
recipes.audioNotes: hit, tick, boom, chime
recipes.notes: Two-column layout language of Velcure scenes 2 and 4; no single reference scene.

inputContract.facts: metric values: number or range facts; display up to 14 characters

capabilities.name: Comparison: two options side by side, matching metrics, then a verdict line
capabilities.sourceReferences: every fact used needs sourceRef and an exact evidence quote
capabilities.purpose: Put two options, groups or periods against each other on the same 1 to 3 metrics.
knownLimitations: exactly two sides
both sides need the same number of metrics
no automatic winner or difference: put a derived fact in a separate scene if needed
value display longer than 14 characters is rejected

candidatesNotInTaxonomy.evidence: velcure s3 beat 4, velcure s4 beat 5, mba s3 beat 5

fieldNotes.usesParticles: true = the scene actively drives the particle field beyond its ambient enter() setup (bursts, modes, targets, fades). Every scene configures ambient particles in enter().
fieldNotes.usesAudio: every scene calls sfx(); audioNotes lists the effects used
fieldNotes.deterministic: 'yes' = no scene-level randomness; particles are always random, so no scene is visually frame-identical
fieldNotes.typicalBeats: beat count of the reference scene(s); for recipes 11 and 12 the beats of one shared scene are split
fieldNotes.sceneExamples: deck and scene id; scenes live in decks/<deck>/scenes.js
